data.name: Claresta
data.gender_notes: Claresta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Clara, meaning clear or shining. In Christian tradition, represents the clarity of faith and the shining light of the soul. The name Claresta carries the meaning “Clear, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Claresta usually hope their child will grow to embody clear, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of clarity, light, and spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Claresta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Clear, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Claresta total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קלריסטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קלריסטה נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'קלרוס', שפירושה ברור או זוהר, ומשויך לנושאים של אור ובהירות רוחנית. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם מייצג את הזוהר והבהירות של האור האלוהי ושל הבנת האמת הרוחנית.

in_greek.name: Κλαρέστα
in_greek.meaning: Λαμπρότα και φωτεινότητα από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κλαρέστα προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'clarus', που σημαίνει φωτεινός ή λαμπός, και συνδέεται με έννοιες του φωτός και της πνευματικής διαύγειας. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη φωτεινότητα και τη διαύγεια που προέρχεται από την θεία αλήθεια.

in_latin.name: Claresta
in_latin.meaning: Clear, bright, and shining with divine light
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Claresta is derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning clear or bright. In Christian tradition, it signifies the clarity and brightness of divine light and spiritual understanding. Historically, names with similar roots were used to express purity and illumination.

in_english.name: Claresta
in_english.meaning: Shining, bright, clear light in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Claresta originates from the Latin 'clarus', meaning clear or bright. It is associated with light, purity, and spiritual clarity. In Christian tradition, Claresta symbolizes the illumination of the soul and the brightness of divine presence. The name reflects qualities of clarity, radiance, and spiritual enlightenment.
